note:
REAL, AUTHENTICATED count — measured locally end-to-end (ephemeral Postgres + seeded admin@springfield.edu SUPER_ADMIN + built API + built web, matching .github/workflows/a11y.yml exactly) after fixing the harness itself (a11y wave, §1): the CI job used to run fully unauthenticated, so every tenant-scoped route rendered the login-redirect shell and this baseline covered public renders only (see git history for the pre-2026-08-24 version of this note). It now logs in for real and adds the template builder route, so this count reflects the actual authenticated app for the first time. errorBaseline is NEW (errors were previously zero-tolerance; see a11y-audit.ts's comment above `errorBaseline` for why that's no longer viable) — DOWN-only, same as warningBaseline, never raise either without fixing the specific regression AND updating this note. Full breakdown of the 10 errors + 2 warnings measured 2026-08-24, each counted once per (route, rule) pair (matching how a11y-audit.ts tallies — not per DOM node):

1. /dashboard color-contrast (1) — 'Local time' + '/ 0 screens online' text in apps/web/src/app/[schoolId]/dashboard/page.tsx. NOT fixed: dashboard/** is on the exclusion list for this wave (owned by other in-flight work per CLAUDE.md's Agent Dispatch Protocol).
2. /screens color-contrast (1) — a List/Map toggle button pair (4.34:1, just under 4.5) + a brand-accent-colored button (4.46:1) in apps/web/src/app/[schoolId]/screens/**. NOT fixed: screens/** is excluded, and the brand-accent button's contrast is tenant-brand-color-dependent (candidate for lib/brand-contrast.ts, not a hardcoded Tailwind swap).
3. /[tenant]/templates color-contrast (1) + nested-interactive (1) — badges/metadata text plus ~100 gallery preview cards whose outer role=button div wraps a focusable descendant, in apps/web/src/app/[schoolId]/templates/page.tsx (or a component it exclusively renders). NOT fixed: templates/page.tsx is explicitly excluded.
4. /[tenant]/templates/builder/[id] color-contrast (1) — #aw-section-header, INSIDE the ANIMATED_WELCOME widget's own rendered DOM (apps/web/src/components/widgets/...), not builder chrome. NOT fixed: this is a widget render tree, out of scope per the standing rule against touching player/widget rendering (Taurus-shipped surfaces render the same widgets). Every OTHER builder-chrome color-contrast/label/select-name violation flagged on this route WAS fixed this wave (PropertiesPanel.tsx, BuilderShell.tsx, BuilderToolbar.tsx) — see the a11y-wave commit for the list.
5. /[tenant]/templates/builder/[id] nested-interactive (1) — BuilderZone.tsx's zone-selection wrapper (role=button, tabIndex, aria-pressed, draggable/resizable) contains the widget's own click-to-edit contenteditable text fields as focusable descendants. NOT fixed: this is the canonical, deliberately-designed zone-selection + in-place-edit interaction (memory: reference_working_template_patterns.md calls BuilderZone a canonical working pattern) — untangling outer-select-vs-inner-edit needs real interaction-design work, not a mechanical aria tweak, and risks regressing drag/resize/click-to-edit if done carelessly.
6. /panic color-contrast (1) — the 4 hold-to-trigger buttons' labels (Lockdown/Evacuate/Shelter/Medical) render white text axe measures at ~1:1 against their own light backdrop (the panic page's background-color detection looks off — worth a real look, just not by this pass). NOT fixed: /panic is the mobile emergency trigger — CLAUDE.md requires lead sign-off for emergency-system changes; report-only per this wave's brief.
7. /panic meta-viewport (1, WARNING) — user-scalable=no on this page's viewport meta. Plausibly intentional (keeps the hold-to-trigger buttons a fixed, thumb-reachable size and blocks accidental pinch during the 3-second hold), but is a real WCAG 1.4.4/1.4.10 concern for low-vision users. NOT fixed: same emergency-system sign-off boundary as #6.
8. /[tenant]/emergency/broadcast color-contrast (1) — the orange 'Warn' button (2.88:1), a live-preview message swatch, a char-counter, and an empty-state caption. NOT fixed: this is the desktop emergency console; same sign-off boundary.
9. /[tenant]/emergency/broadcast label (1) — an auto-refresh-interval number input with no accessible name. NOT fixed: same emergency-console sign-off boundary.
10. /player meta-viewport (1, WARNING) — same user-scalable=no pattern as /panic, on the kiosk player route. NOT fixed: player is a Taurus-shipped surface; the standing rule is design-for-cutting-edge-LCD/degrade-only-for-Taurus, and disabling it outright wasn't in scope for a harness-verification pass.

Fixed this wave (2026-08-24) and NOT in the baseline above: Sidebar.tsx 'Main Menu' + user-email/role labels (shared chrome, ~7 routes); apps/web/src/app/[schoolId]/reviews/page.tsx and components/branding/{BrandingWizard,BrandingLivePreview}.tsx (both routes now scan CLEAN — 0 errors); PropertiesPanel.tsx's SelectField + FontFamilyField shared components (missing accessible names, used across many widget types) and its section-header/badge/hint-text contrast (text-slate-400/80 section headers ×15, plus the countdown date/time inputs' missing labels); BuilderShell.tsx's panel-tab contrast + canvas hint text; BuilderToolbar.tsx's resolution/orientation badges.

To lower either baseline: run `pnpm a11y:ci` locally (see a11y-audit.ts's header comment for the full authenticated-run recipe), confirm the new count, update the number(s) here, and replace this note's relevant bullet with what changed.
